# _generated — do not edit

Everything in this directory is written by `genesis-ctx index` (47-03) from the tag
files (`context/tags/*.toml`) and the source documents. **Do not hand-edit these files.**
Edits here are overwritten on the next `index` and will be flagged by `genesis-ctx lint`
(the generated files are expected to match a fresh regeneration).

Files that will live here (created in 47-05 onward):

- `adr-digest.md` — one line per ADR: `ADR-NNN [areas] (amended by …) — <rule>`
- `lesson-digest.md` — one line per lesson: `L-NNN [areas] — <rule>`
- `area-catalog.md` — one line per area

To (re)generate: `genesis-ctx index`.
